_comment: Operator-enrolled Product Admin manifest signers (PIC_TRUSTED_SIGNERS_FILE). Public keys only. A registration names the approved kid; HQ never trusts a key carried inside a manifest. No signer is enrolled until its owner has generated and handed over the public key through an approved channel. PLACEHOLDER: the CF Meet Admin entry (kid cfmeet-staging-manifest-2026-11, Ed25519, must equal CFMEET_ADMIN_MANIFEST_SIGNING_KID) points at a public key file that does not exist until the operator writes the handed-over PUBLIC key there.
